edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The aggregate purchase price for the Shares shall be USD 35,000,000 (the “Purchase Price”), payable in immediately available funds at Closing. The Buyer shall not set off or withhold any amount from the Purchase Price except as expressly required by applicable law.
edits.name: Seller's proposed purchase price and payment terms

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days after signing, subject to satisfaction or waiver of the conditions to Closing set forth in this Agreement, or on such other date as the parties may agree in writing.
edits.name: Closing mechanics

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents, as of signing and as of Closing, that the financial statements included in the agreed disclosure materials have been prepared in accordance with the accounting principles stated therein, in all material respects. The Seller’s representations are qualified by the disclosures made in the disclosure schedules.
edits.name: Qualified financial statement representation

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the limitations in this Section, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer against losses to the extent resulting from a breach of the Seller’s representations expressly set forth in this Agreement. The Seller shall have no liability for any claim unless written notice describing the claim in reasonable detail is delivered within the applicable survival period. The Seller’s aggregate liability under this Section shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the Purchase Price, and the Seller shall not be liable for consequential, punitive, or special damages, except to the extent awarded to a third party.
edits.name: Limited seller indemnity

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you for your proposal. The Seller is prepared to move on price and proposes a Purchase Price of USD 32,000,000, subject to customary purchase-price adjustments to be set forth in the definitive agreement. The Seller cannot agree to unilateral setoff rights; any setoff should be limited to amounts agreed in writing by the parties or finally determined to be due by a court of competent jurisdiction. We have revised the indemnity provision to address fundamental representations and fraud, and proposed survival periods and claim procedures as a basis for further discussion.

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The aggregate purchase price for the Shares shall be USD 32,000,000 (the “Purchase Price”), subject to the purchase-price adjustments expressly set forth in this Agreement, and payable in immediately available funds at Closing. The Buyer shall not set off or withhold any amount from the Purchase Price or any other amount payable under this Agreement, except for amounts agreed in writing by the Seller or finally determined to be due by a court of competent jurisdiction.
edits.name: Purchase Price

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the limitations in this Section, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer against losses to the extent resulting from a breach of the Seller’s representations expressly set forth in this Agreement. The Seller shall have no liability for any claim unless written notice describing the claim in reasonable detail is delivered within the applicable survival period. The representations other than Fundamental Representations shall survive Closing for eighteen (18) months. The Fundamental Representations shall survive Closing for six (6) years, and claims for fraud shall survive for the applicable statute of limitations. The Seller’s aggregate liability under this Section for breaches of representations other than Fundamental Representations shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the Purchase Price. The Seller’s aggregate liability for breaches of Fundamental Representations shall not exceed the Purchase Price. The foregoing caps and the exclusion of consequential, punitive, or special damages shall not apply to claims for fraud; provided that “fraud” means actual and intentional common-law fraud by the Seller in making an express representation in this Agreement, and not constructive fraud, negligent misrepresentation, or any claim based on recklessness. The exclusion of consequential, punitive, or special damages shall not limit recovery of such damages to the extent actually awarded to a third party in a claim for which indemnification is available under this Section. The parties shall cooperate in good faith on customary claim-notice, defense, settlement, and mitigation procedures. “Fundamental Representations” means the Seller’s representations concerning its organization and authority, due authorization and enforceability, title to the Shares, and brokers’ fees.
edits.name: Indemnity
